rationale: Both Prajyot and You Liang are deeply invested in bridging sim-to-real robot learning and humanoid robotics, with complementary expertise across the pipeline—Prajyot brings hands-on experience with Isaac Sim, ROS 2, and imitation learning frameworks (BC-GMM) from her Meta work, while You Liang brings research-to-industry perspective from NVIDIA GEAR and BAIR on generalist foundation models for robot learning. Their shared conviction that both classical robotics fundamentals and modern AI/ML are essential, combined with You Liang's open-source infrastructure advocacy and Prajyot's industry-scale execution experience, positions them well to explore collaboration on robot learning infrastructure or next-gen embodied AI projects.
intro_message: Prajyot Patil, meet You Liang Tan — you're both working on the intersection of imitation learning and humanoid robotics, and share convictions about bridging classical robotics (ROS, SLAM, motion planning) with modern foundation models; You Liang's research background and open-source focus could be valuable as Prajyot scales sim-to-real pipelines at Meta.
